lesson.text: The solar system is the Sun and everything that orbits it: 8 planets, their moons, dwarf planets, asteroids and comets.
The 4 inner planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) are small and rocky. The 4 outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) are giants made mostly of gas and ice.
Distances are huge: Earth is about 150 million km from the Sun; Neptune is about 30 times farther.
Jupiter is so big that more than 1,000 Earths could fit inside it. The Sun is so big that more than a million Earths could fit inside it.
